Match all 14 electric tool families to their declared battery tier; retain four original LV grid/wear tests and full generated-row network guard.
Head tint layer1, overlay layer2; source Drill generic block-use cost200 EU, not100.

Adopted T0 small/large crystal chargers are valid ULV devices.

Remove duplicate bale_ prefix in three grass bale fixture IDs.
